senses.definition: An angular mil, a unit of angular measurement equal to ¹⁄₆₄₀₀ of a complete circle. At 1000 metres one mil subtends about one metre (0.98 m). Also ¹⁄₆₀₀₀ and ¹⁄₆₃₀₀ are used in other countries.
A unit of measurement equal to ¹⁄₁₀₀₀ of an inch (25.4 µm), usually used for thin objects, such as sheets of plastic.
examples: For this task, I prefer the plastic sheeting that is 10 mils thick.

quotes.text: If made of plastic, is minimum of at least 2.25 mils (thousandths of an inch) thick.
